results.note: The same WeChat principal resolves to one user from any client, both clients share one timeline, and no second account row or account system is created.

Timeline, diary and reminders are reached only through a server-owned scoped repository: another user's entries are invisible, a cross-user delete changes nothing, a suspended user loses the surface, and no context or a forged context is refused. The companion capability set contains no Owner capability.

The check-in module imports nothing at all and reports zero model calls on every path including the send path; wording comes from a frozen Chinese template table, quiet hours handle the midnight wrap-around, and a disabled user is refused before any scheduling arithmetic. Sweeping a full week hour by hour, a disabled user receives exactly zero proactive messages, an opted-in user does receive them, and turning it off again silences it.
